counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline_en: Query and configure Codex Rules behavior and rule files
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to understand or adjust Codex rule behavior

howto.what: 启用插件后自动运行:会话开始和提交提示时注入静态项目指令,Codex 执行 apply_patch 后按文件匹配注入对应规则;动态输出去重后作为附加上下文注入,不改写工具输出。
howto.when: 当用户问起 Codex Rules 的行为、注入的项目规则、支持的规则文件位置等,或插件启用后自动接管时。

say.text: Codex Rules 支持哪些规则文件位置?
say.note: 会列出 CONTEXT.md、.omo/rules 等来源
会给出 CODEX_RULES_DISABLED=1 等开关

howto.what_en: Once enabled, the plugin runs automatically: it injects static project instructions on SessionStart and UserPromptSubmit, and matching file rules after apply_patch. Dynamic output is deduplicated per session; tool output is not rewritten.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks about Codex Rules behavior, injected project rules, supported rule file locations, matching, or environment configuration. It also runs automatically once enabled.
